name: Kraft Jell-O Strawberry Gelatin Dessert (Prepared)
whyItWorks: The classic hospital and colonoscopy clear-liquid prep staple. Gelatin is derived from collagen peptides and water. It dissolves into a completely liquid state at body temperature, leaving zero digestive residue in the intestinal tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Prepare according to box directions or buy pre-made cups. Excellent for acute flare-up hydration and gentle sweetness.
watchOuts: Avoid red-colored gelatin 48 hours prior to a scheduled colonoscopy.
